overview_description.description: Dash0 is an observability platform that enables engineering teams to monitor, analyze, and manage application performance and system behavior. The platform collects and processes telemetry data such as logs, metrics, and traces, allowing users to investigate issues and understand system interactions. It offers tools for visualizing distributed systems, helping teams identify bottlenecks and troubleshoot incidents. Dash0 integrates with existing infrastructure and supports open standards to streamline data ingestion and analysis. Its features assist teams in maintaining system reliability and improving operational workflows through data-driven insights.

about_short_description.short_description: Dash0 is an OpenTelemetry-native observability platform for collecting, transmitting, and analyzing distributed system data.

product.name: Logs Management
product.description: A tool for instant filtering and searching of diverse logs using OpenTelemetry semantic conventions to provide context and identify patterns quickly.

product.name: Metrics Monitoring
product.description: Centralizes Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics to monitor infrastructure and services with dashboards, integrations, and alerts based on OpenTelemetry conventions.

product.name: Traces Analysis
product.description: Provides real-time search, filtering, and detailed views of traces to identify errors and bottlenecks with heatmaps and contextual data on logs, events, and resources.

product.name: Dashboards
product.description: Enables creation and customization of dashboards to visualize metrics, logs, and traces, with support for configuration as code and compatibility with Perses.

product.name: AI-Enhanced Observability
product.description: Uses AI technologies like LLMs and machine learning to auto-structure telemetry data, reduce repetitive tasks, and enhance logs, metrics, and traces without manual configuration.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Provides pre-built integrations, dashboards, alerts, and views for instant observability across various technology stacks with one-click setup.
